task:
Explore: stop pre-filling the results list on load.

Owner report (production, 2026-11-01): every visit to /explore immediately lists the same 24 systems "Near Sol" because, with no anchor chosen, ExploreWorkspace.svelte runs the results query with Sol as the implicit reference (heading falls back to 'Near Sol'; the query is enabled by `rankingUrlReady` alone). The owner wants an empty list until they ask for something.

Required behaviour:
1. On a fresh /explore load with no anchor in page state and no Finder state in the URL, do NOT run the results search. The results panel shows an empty state instead of rows: heading "Systems" (not "Near Sol"), and text "Search for a system above to see what is near it." with no Pin/Compare/Watch rows and no result markers on the map. The galaxy map, regions, density layers and saved systems still load as today.
2. Results load as soon as the commander picks a system in the search box (an anchor), exactly as today, with the heading "Near <system>".
3. Deep links must still work: an anchor restored from page state/history, and (behind VITE_FINDER_F4_ENABLED) any URL that carries Finder state such as an archetype ranking, offset or min tier, still load results on first render. With the F4 flag on, choosing an archetype other than Any also loads the galaxy-wide ranking without an anchor, as today; only the "no anchor + Any + no URL state" case becomes empty.
4. Do not leave a stale previous list visible after the anchor is cleared: clearing the search/anchor returns to the empty state.
5. Keep bounded workload: the empty state issues no search or rankings request (assert this in a unit test by checking the API mock is not called).

Tests: update apps/web/src/lib/features/explore/ExploreWorkspace.test.ts for the empty state, the anchor case, the deep-link case and (flag on) the archetype case. Update Cypress specs that assumed results on load (apps/web/cypress/e2e/product-journey.cy.ts, review-lab.cy.ts and any other spec that waits for the initial '@search' or 'Near Sol'): make them search for an anchor first, keeping their intercept aliases unique. Update any Python contract test that pins 'Near Sol' (search tests/). Add a CHANGES.md entry. Run pnpm check, pnpm test and pnpm build in apps/web.
